PDF22–25/53. Paladin-specific eligibility. First-character HP10+CON; subsequent Paladin level adds max(1,d10+CON) or max(1,6+CON), one D10 Hit Die. Total-level XP/PB and retroactive CON correction consume429, never Fighter731 eligibility. Positive: CON+2 fixed increase8; rolled1 with CON-3 increases1; CON17→18 at total8 adds8 retroactively in addition to new-level HP. Negative: D12/fixed7/D8/fixed5, first-level10 on later-class entry, rerolled saved die, missing XP. Exactly ONE new direct429consumer; all other paths use this adapter.

Independently reject total21,unqualified current-class configurations and unknown source paths. Class-application XP/live PB select canonical TOTAL-level advancement independently of Paladin-level feature/slot/HP rows. Shared effect execution adds no Paladin or other-class admission requirement to its targets. Commit choices, injectable dice, derived state and history atomically. Durable receipt binds payload: retry/replay/reload/reconnect returns exact result; conflicting payload and stale state reject. Concurrent confirmations commit once.
